verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way for users to set persistent custom instructions or preferences that shape every response. The only related item is a passing mention that account merging keeps Poke's 'Memory' (poke-docs-20), which does not say users can define standing instructions. Recipe-level inputContext (poke-docs-40) is a per-recipe setup field for recipe creators, an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response
